Detailed Description

Shared audio/video run state for native workers and asynchronous host adapters. The owner serializes transitions; workers may query should_run atomically. Adapters release their resources before finish_stop, including failed starts.

  session_av_state_destroy (session_av_state_t * state)


Free a state allocated by session_av_state_create(); NULL

  states.
